label: Part of spacetime and composition component
term: part of spacetime and composition component
resolution: Frame.partOf is a supplied relation, with improper self-parthood allowed. Case.ComponentOf ranges over quantitative, matter/form, essence/esse or other composition components. Case.IsSimple means ¬Composite, not a new part-free predicate. The two selected-world bridges explicitly connect existing proper spacetime parts to those components and their whole's compositeness; neither follows from the API or from a converse of composite-has-component. Part N1 and occupant N1 are different propositions: a control keeps occupant N1 while part N1 fails. A whole can be located in its global region and an improper part of itself without an external spatial container. The one-existing-whole escape denies a distinct pair; bridge-omission controls expose mathematical dictionary gaps, not blanket historical rivals. No inference about the God-naming implication, all God concepts, actual metaphysical possibility or counted defeat follows.
